summary: Frontend-only test of the consolidated individual->business flow. Tests covered: removed upgrade surfaces (chip + card), dashboard ActivationChecklist account-type choice, /settings Account details chooser presence for the individual fixture company 113, business static badge for Dev Store (id=1), full conversion flow (113 individual -> business), and mobile responsive checks. All functional user journeys PASS: dashboard choice -> settings chooser -> pick business -> country US -> Save changes -> account becomes 'BUSINESS' in header switcher AND settings now shows only account-type-business-badge (no toggle). However a real duplicate-DOM bug was found on /settings that must be fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: The entire CompanyDetailsSection is rendered TWICE on /settings?section=company. DOM shows: [data-testid=account-type-chooser] count=2, [data-testid=account-type-business-badge] count=2 (Dev Store business), input#country count=2, 5 x .MuiAccordion-root, 4 x <form>. The second copy is visible (offsetParent != null) but positioned lower down and contains an empty/duplicate render (empty innerText on the 2nd chooser). Parent chain of both duplicates is IDENTICAL: MuiCollapse-wrapper > MuiCollapse-wrapperInner > MuiAccordion-region > MuiAccordionDetails, meaning two full accordions exist. Only one <CompanySettingsDialog inline> is declared in pages/settings/index.tsx (line 285) — the duplication appears to come from inside CompanySettingsDialog/index.tsx or from the Formik render wrapper. This breaks strict-mode locators (locator('input#country') throws strict-mode violation) and causes badge count = 2 for a business account.

Save button label is 'Save changes' (lowercase 'c'), and it has NO data-testid. Problem statement uses label 'Save Changes' (capital C). Add data-testid=settings-save-changes-btn for reliable automation and normalize casing.

The problem statement says 'Required to become a business: business name + country (address/VAT optional)', but the UI marks State*, City*, Address Line 1*, Zip Code* as required (with asterisk labels) when Country is selected. The Save nonetheless succeeded (no client-side blocking), so the asterisks are misleading. Remove the * or drop the requirement to match spec.

Expected success toast 'Your account is now a business account.' was NOT observed after clicking Save changes (waited 9s, queried [role=alert], MuiAlert, MuiSnackbar, Toastify — all empty). Conversion itself succeeded (header switcher now reads BUSINESS and settings shows only account-type-business-badge). Either toast is not firing, is not accessible (no role), or has a very short auto-hide < 9s. Consider adding data-testid and asserting a longer visible duration.

action_items: Fix duplicate rendering of CompanyDetailsSection on /settings?section=company (chooser/badge/form/country appear twice). Investigate CompanySettingsDialog/index.tsx render tree or SSR/CSR hydration to prevent double-mount.
Add data-testid to the 'Save changes' button (e.g. settings-save-changes-btn) and normalize label capitalization vs docs ('Save Changes' vs 'Save changes').
Ensure the success toast 'Your account is now a business account.' actually renders and is discoverable ([role=alert] or data-testid).
Reconcile required-field asterisks (State/City/Address/Zip) with the documented 'business name + country only' requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: pages/settings/index.tsx only mounts one <CompanySettingsDialog inline> yet the browser DOM shows two full account-details accordions — the doubling happens INSIDE the dialog; likely a stale second render or an SSR/CSR mismatch from dynamic import at line 70. Worth logging renders of CompanyDetailsSection to confirm.
Save button relies on visible label matching for automation; add stable data-testid.
Duplicate DOM inflates business-badge count to 2 even for a single business company, which will trip strict test-id counts in future tests.
seed_data_creation: NONE — but the conversion is PERMANENT: fixture company_id=113 ('Account Type Test') has been flipped from individual -> business as documented in the problem statement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Company 113 is now BUSINESS (converted during this run). To re-test the individual->business flow, a new individual fixture is needed. Removed surfaces (company-upgrade-*, settings-upgrade-business-card) confirmed absent. Dashboard dash2026-account-type-choice + choose-individual/choose-business exist and business click routes to /settings?section=company. The Save button label is 'Save changes' (not 'Save Changes'). #country and account-type-chooser resolve to 2 nodes each on /settings due to a duplicate-render bug — use .first when locating. Success toast text was empty at check time (may just be timing).
rca of the issue: Duplicate DOM on /settings: pages/settings/index.tsx renders <CompanySettingsDialog inline open ... /> exactly once for the selected company, but the resulting DOM contains TWO complete Company Settings accordions with identical parent chains (MuiCollapse-wrapperInner > MuiAccordion-region). The empty second copy suggests either (a) the Formik <Formik>{({...})=><>...</>}</Formik> render prop is being invoked twice with stale state, (b) a hidden earlier instance of the dialog persists (e.g., previous selectedCompany not unmounted), or (c) dynamic import (line 70) is bootstrapping both a placeholder and the resolved component. Reproduction: log in, open /settings?section=company, run document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=account-type-chooser]').length -> 2. Mitigation: instrument CompanyDetailsSection mounts with useEffect(() => console.log('mount', company_id)), then thread down until the second mount is identified; ensure only one instance renders. Also verify that when selectedCompany changes we don't accidentally leave the previous dialog mounted (React reconciliation should handle this if keys are correct).
